Complete analytic candidate; charged time is a worst-case bound over the algorithm's own coins, not a full-scale execution.

Each of the q records stores three 256-bit words (digest, u, v); the per-record cost charges the packed compression, the digest transpose, the message-identity transpose that materializes (u, v), the record store, and the counting-sort grouping over the three-word records.

Declared time_log2 = 125.8 is the register-rich, rotation-as-reindexing per-record accounting; the proof discloses stricter accountings (per-bit-plane rotation surcharge, pessimistic four-ops-per-gate memory model), all of which remain below the prior generic exponent 128.22.
